description: Initial unvalidated demonstration rules. Thresholds require business approval.

rules.description: Bank beneficiary does not match a contracted party.
rules.explanatory_text: Verify that the receiving bank account belongs to a contracted transaction party.

rules.description: A required end user has not been identified.
rules.explanatory_text: Identify the final end user before the transaction proceeds.

rules.description: The transaction end use is missing or insufficiently specific.
rules.explanatory_text: Provide a specific commercial end use rather than a placeholder.

rules.description: A new counterparty requests payment terms beyond approved policy.
rules.explanatory_text: Review payment protection such as deposit, letter of credit, or insurance.

rules.description: Requested unsecured exposure exceeds the demonstration policy threshold.
rules.explanatory_text: Reduce exposure or document management approval and risk controls.
